training_eligibility: Run fixed RF comparison only if at least 80% of TRAIN left gyro windows also have all right gyro samples, and every frozen outer fit has both FoG classes; otherwise stop after the input audit without redraw/imputation.
alignment: Anchor the 120-point/30-point grid to each original left-gyro contiguous run. Keep a dual window only if all 120 right gyro rows are finite; never restart a separate right-driven grid or fill gaps. Matched left control is the first three channels of that exact same window.
features: Existing 11 filtered statistics per gyro axis, left33 vs left+right66. No new handcrafted coordination features, context lags, losses, deep architecture, sensor rotation, sampling or postprocessing.
audit: TRAIN only: left/right valid support, current saved participant-held-out control errors, demeaned vector RMS distributions, and closest pure non-FoG/pure-FoG pairs within participant/activity with disjoint windows >=6s apart. Distances use StandardScaler fitted on TRAIN only, normalized by sqrt(feature_count). Pair selection is deliberately closest-left-feature, descriptive, not independent classification or an impossibility proof.
case_policy: For non-FoG Stand and left/right Turn, take the closest eligible saved TRAIN-OOF false-positive/pure-FoG pair in left-feature distance; same participant and activity, nonoverlapping records/time. Explicitly report no-pair groups. Never claim subjective voluntary stop or measured step completion.
fitting: Use previous frozen TRAIN14 outer participant folds. Fixed RF parameters; each TRAIN participant scored only by outer fit excluding that person. TRAIN pooled OOF chooses threshold by F1/BA/higher cutoff, then fresh final RF fit on all joint-eligible TRAIN windows. Actual fit people listed; no pretending missing-input people were fitted.
lock_policy: Freeze models/thresholds before separate VALIDATION evaluation; no VALIDATION tuning/refit or new TEST windows/scores. Prior development cohorts already inspected, not a new blind test.
support_policy: Primary feature comparison uses identical joint-eligible windows for both models. Also score the frozen left control on all naturally available left windows to show the extra-input coverage cost. Include every raw TRAIN/VALIDATION record and event; no prediction is unknown, not normal.
development_gate: Joint-window bilateral vs matched left: higher F1, no higher false alarm seconds, no lower FoG-time recall. Also require bilateral time-support fraction no lower than frozen left on its natural input pool. Even a pass does not auto-replace the default or establish external generalization.
